name: 323. Cohere chat usage reports billed units (cohere chat billed units)
description: TXE-6596. Cohere's /v2/chat usage has billed_units (what Cohere bills) and tokens (what it processed). When billed_units carries input and output tokens they fill prompt_tokens and completion_tokens, and the processed counts go to usage.processed_tokens; without billed token counts the processed counts stay in prompt_tokens and completion_tokens. The streamed final usage frame maps the same way and has its own case.
